final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, 3 of 3.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title to Unicode NFD form and strips the combining marks before calling `slugify`. I didn't touch the vendored `slugify` because `vendor/README.md` says never to edit it by hand.

The shop's `src/shop/product-url.js` uses the same vendored `slugify`, so product URLs still drop accents. I left that alone since you asked about blog posts. If you want product slugs fixed too, the same normalization could go in that file.

I haven't committed anything.
